capabilities: Add notes, blocks, links, folders and search results to prioritized review queues
Navigate repetitions in a queue with next, current and dismiss commands
Edit a repetition's interval, priority, next repetition date and notes
Auto-add notes to queues via tags or when new notes are created
Schedule repetitions with Simple or A-Factor spacing styles
disambiguation: Not a writing or editing tool; it schedules existing notes and blocks into review queues rather than helping compose text.
extras: README warns the plugin uses private Obsidian APIs and may break after updates, is not supported on mobile yet, and links to external videos and articles for learning; also warns that low priority numbers mean high priority.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to schedule individual notes or blocks into prioritized queues for repeated review over time.

relations.evidence: this is the way priorities work in SuperMemo and having used it for a couple years
I strongly recommend installing the Natural Language Dates plugin alongside this plugin

summary: Spaced-repetition plugin that adds notes and blocks from the vault to prioritized queues for incremental review over time.
